metadata.notes: Week 5 fork B. One bullet attested in the room.

target.goalStatement: I want a daytime job counting stock and helping customers, not night warehouse work.

workHistory.title: Grocery department lead
dutiesFacts: Opened the store four mornings a week and counted dairy and produce before customers arrived.
Trained six new hires on how to rotate stock and write down what we threw away.
Called the warehouse when we ran short on milk or bread so the next truck could fix it.

workHistory.title: Cafeteria assistant
dutiesFacts: Served lunch to about 400 students a day and kept the line moving.
Followed food-safety rules and signed the temperature log.

education.credential: Certificate in Logistics and Supply Chain

resumeBullets.prompt: Write one resume bullet from these facts only.
sourceFacts: Opened the store four mornings a week and counted dairy and produce before customers arrived.
Trained six new hires on how to rotate stock and write down what we threw away.
resumeBullets.aiDraft: Spearheaded a 15% waste-reduction initiative while onboarding a high-performing team of six associates.
resumeBullets.learnerEdited: Counted dairy and produce each morning and wrote down what we threw away so we ordered less waste. Trained six new hires to do the same.

interviewAnswers.prompt: Tell me about a time you trained someone new.
sourceFacts: Trained six new hires on how to rotate stock and write down what we threw away.
interviewAnswers.aiDraft: I am a natural leader who mentored six associates to exceed KPIs in waste reduction.
interviewAnswers.learnerEdited: I trained six new people. I showed them how to rotate milk and write down what we tossed at night. I stayed until they could do it without me.
